compositional_deconstruction.background: Two steep dark-green mountains form a valley beneath turbulent clouds. A circular cave opening glows red in the left peak while ribbons of rain and mist sweep toward the right peak.

elements.desc: A tall woman with long black hair floats diagonally across the valley. She wears layered crimson and charcoal robes whose edges dissolve into rain clouds. A crown of curved black stone frames her pale face, and one raised hand guides a ring of white lightning.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A storm-dark mountain fills the lower frame. Its circular cave mouth glows deep crimson while one dense thundercloud spirals upward around the central creature.

elements.desc: A colossal wingless serpent forms a powerful spiral across the square. It has glossy black scales, a long horned head, narrow white eyes and molten-gold markings running along the spine. Lightning follows the coils and converges around the open jaws.

Five rounded boulders with short rock legs hurry through the lower foreground like a compact flock. Their simple silhouettes curve around the giant's feet and emphasize its scale without competing with the central body.
